- Amount formatting now uses the shared locale-aware `format_money()` helper, including grouping and signs.
- Added regression tests for credit ordering, currency formatting, and long-invoice pagination.
- Consolidated page-height calculations and reduced repeated header reservation, producing two pages for an 86-item invoice.
- PDF tests: 14 passed, 1 skipped; billing suite: 83 passed, 4 skipped; Ruff and whitespace checks passed. Golden PDFs remained byte-stable. Visual comparison of three generated PDFs is still useful.
